name: Wings of the Wyrmling
body:
School transmutation; Level arcanist 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal (must be a dragon)
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A golden flow travels over you, restoring the litheness of your youth. You lose all age-related penalties to Dexterity, and your flight maneuverability improves to average.

Book of Magic: Dragon Spells and Archetypes. 2017, Jon Brazer Enterprises
